pageless: MCP-callable digest demonstrator for the shared _sha256 bundle, no interactive UI of its own, presented through the shared MCP tool catalog (mcp.html). A node page would be an unlinked NAV-ISLAND-1 island until an ASSEMBLE row wires it into chaingraph-hub.html (ACCT-INFRA-KERNELS-BUILD-SPEC.md Sec.0.1: demonstrators are page-less).
description: Digests a caller-supplied UTF-8 string or hex byte string with SHA-256, or computes HMAC-SHA256 over it under a caller-supplied hex key, and echoes the algorithm id. It exists to give the shared guest-safe SHA-256 bundle a live execution surface: the kernel carries the bundle verbatim, so its fixtures, property floor and execution_hash exercise the exact bytes other kernels will later inline. Input is bounded at 64 KiB; anything else (unknown mode, unknown encoding, non-string or non-hex input, missing or non-hex key, oversize input) is rejected with a closed reason code and no digest. The kernel makes no policy decision and is not a signature scheme: HMAC here is a keyed digest over data the caller supplies, and the key travels in the request.
deferred_reason: New gpu:false demonstrator node, art-751-sha256-hmac-digest-demonstrator, landed 2026-10-17 by SHARED-SHA256-BUNDLE-1. No GPU prove has been run and none is proposed here. Deferred per the section 18 steady-state rule (RIDER-KERNEL.md); the node is not yet registered in the assembled graph, so the section 18 denominator does not see it and the ceiling moves in the ASSEMBLE-LAND that registers it (SO #59). Run GPU-CYCLE-PREFLIGHT-1's static pre-screen and measure user_cycles with runq-cpu exec before booking: the input is bounded at 65536 bytes, so the worst-case vector is the 64 KiB digest.
